kpis.description_fr: Backlog Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA) : ~5500 avions commandés. Visibilité 10+ ans, surreservation des slots 2030+.
kpis.description_en: Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA) backlog: ~5500 aircraft ordered. 10+ years visibility, overbooked 2030+ slots.

kpis.description_fr: Livraisons 737 MAX. Trajectoire montée en cadence post Alaska 1282 accident jan 2024. Cap FAA 38/mois.
kpis.description_en: 737 MAX deliveries. Production ramp post Alaska 1282 accident Jan 2024. FAA cap 38/month.

kpis.description_fr: Livraisons 787 (wide-body). Récupération graduelle post halt 2020-2022. Production rate target 10/mois 2026.
kpis.description_en: 787 (wide-body) deliveries. Gradual recovery post 2020-2022 halt. Target production rate 10/month by 2026.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog Boeing Defense, Space & Security : F-15EX, F/A-18, T-7A, KC-46, MQ-25, satellites. Margins sous pression contrats fixe.
kpis.description_en: Boeing Defense, Space & Security backlog: F-15EX, F/A-18, T-7A, KC-46, MQ-25, satellites. Margins under fixed-price pressure.

kpis.description_fr: FCF négatif 2024 (~-12 Mds $) dû à grève IAM + halt MAX + raises capital. Retour FCF positif attendu 2026.
kpis.description_en: Negative FCF 2024 (~-$12B) due to IAM strike + MAX halt + capital raises. Positive FCF expected 2026.
